story.title: A Bad Day for Everyone
story.blurb: Non-canon. Sanya drags a leashed, collared Emmett out of the ship on a "special mission" to a roadside diner, with a suspicious Garrick trailing behind.

lines.text: Within the depths of the bruhium Pummeler, Sanya was making her way back from the temple. Despite having a fun time with Mary, she still was upset about having to come back to the crew. The moment she stepped foot back in her room, she smelled a familiar stench—her favorite Squoatling. She had forgotten she tied Emmett to her headrest via his leash. She loved to mess with him, and this whole leash idea was great. The Squoatling, of course, was fast asleep on the floor like the dog he was.
"Good night, Emmett," Sanya softly whispered, giving him a kick to the groin in a compassionate way. The Squoatling immediately woke up in pain.
